title: Frozen Star
subtitle: Research vessel Tern · 10 Schwarzschild radii above Erebus

text: Good morning, Doctor. It is 06:40, ship time.
We reached station above Erebus at 04:12. Ten Schwarzschild radii out, holding steady.
The black disk is Erebus's shadow. It is about two and a half times wider than the horizon itself.
